summary: Master the art of Designing Monitoring and Evaluation Frameworks with our expert-led training. Gain practical insights for effective project evaluation.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation frameworks help program managers, M&E officers and development professionals assess whether initiatives create meaningful change. They learn to map a theory of change, select indicators, establish baselines and targets, and choose data collection and evaluation methods to support credible evidence and program decisions.
audienceIntro: This course serves program managers, development professionals, policy analysts, and organizational leaders who must design, implement, and oversee monitoring and evaluation systems that demonstrate program effectiveness and guide strategic decisions.
modules: Theory of Change and Program Logic Development
Cost-Effectiveness and Value for Money Analysis
Digital M&E Tools and Data Management
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required, though participants benefit from basic familiarity with program management concepts. Participants should bring a current or planned program scenario to use for practical exercises throughout the course.
